Kickoff: Friday, Nov. 13 at 8:45 PM CET / 7:45 PM GMT / 2:45 PM ET / 11:45 AM PT [...] Mitrovic is back but still building up his minutes, which makes him a bench option more than a starter. Milenkovic returns from the injury that kept him out of Serbia's first four Nations League games, and Vanja Milinkovic-Savic holds the goalkeeper's place after Predrag Rajkovic was left out.
